items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: Mr. Jenkins' son, Edmund, who had won seven consecutive scholarships... was back, uh, and he took charge of the band. It's quite an honor to have the son of the president directed the band.

ctx.x: and that time I had come back home. How old an institution is the Jenkins orphanage?
The Jenkins orphanage was established I think around about 1890, I believe, by the Reverend Jenkins.
You knew him personally then, right? Well, I'm his son-in-law. Oh. I mean you'd known the family right there then before.
